title: scrophularia alata var. borealikoreana
intro: Scrophularia alata var. borealikoreana, commonly known as Korean wormwood or Borneo scorpion grass, is a plant species belonging to the family Scrophulariaceae. It is valued for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which may help to alleviate symptoms of various conditions such as fever, cough, and respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of Scrophularia alata var. borealikoreana include expectorant, anti-tussive, and anti-inflammatory effects, which may aid in relieving respiratory congestion and cough. The bioactive constituents of this plant include iridoid glycosides, phenolic compounds, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
